about_the_game:
Alternative Alliance Alpha is a short and gentle sci-fi post-apocalyptic adventure set in the distant future.
Take control of the young man Jinovika as you explore the world beyond the colony—gathering resources, meeting new people, and enjoying everyday life in this strange world.
The demo version allows you to play the first half of Alternative Alliance Alpha.
